_doc: Recipe for the community baseline saves (docs/23 #1, docs/TESTING.md section 7). Run: node tools/harness/baseline-save.ts --world bp. Saves cannot be shared (EA data), so every contributor rebuilds them. fingerprint is null until measured on a real aged save: --check prints the line to paste. Equivalence is by fingerprint, not bit-identical: docs/27 section 1.2 says a start-up seed alone may not make aging repeat.
